teaser: A stage lit for a story no one asked for. A ledger balanced before breakfast. Life path 3 wants words and color; ISTJ keeps the books straight. You carry both: the pull to speak and the discipline to check your work twice before you say it. Most people picture a 3 as loud and an ISTJ as quiet; you're the version who writes the punchline and then revises it for accuracy. What's particular here is a built-in editor on a path that usually runs on impulse — charm filtered through someone who distrusts anything unverified, including their own charm.
